scenario.title: Freedom of Information
scenario.text:
All players have been issues subpoenas to reveal their current time.
All players have the option to refuse and take the matter to court.
If you lose in court, you are compelled to reveal your time (+2 heat).
If you continue to refuse, you will be arrested.

effects.text: Everyone reveals their time or goes to court (lose: reveal and +2 heat; keep refusing: arrested).

scenario.title: Christmas Crackers
scenario.text:
All alive players are rewarded during the festive period with an item from the list below:
* Collectable
* Promotion
* Job Opportunity
* Hospital Item
* Shortcut

effects.text: Every alive player takes one item of their choice: a collectable, promotion, job opportunity, hospital item or shortcut (the admin hands them out).

scenario.title: Experimental Drug
scenario.text:
You have managed to be part of a drug trial.
Roll the die (charms +1 to roll):
1. +20 minutes bleeding
2. No effect
3. -20 minutes bleeding
4. -40 minutes bleeding
5. -60 minutes bleeding
6. Remove all bleeding effect
You can also offer this drug to other players and they must roll also.

effects.text: Charms add 1 to the roll. You can offer the drug to other players; they roll too.

scenario.title: Contraband
scenario.text:
Contraband (collectables with red names) have been found in the city and the Judge has been called to enforce the law.
The Judge decides which players should be searched.
If a player is found to have contraband, all their contraband is discarded, the Judge takes 2 hours, and the player receives +1 heat.
[IF NO JUDGE IS IN PLAY, DISCARD THIS SCENARIO CARD]

effects.text: No Judge in play? Discard this card. Otherwise the Judge searches players: contraband (red cards) is discarded, the Judge takes 2 hours and the player gets +1 heat.

scenario.title: Chief Justice
scenario.text:
The Supreme Court has raised concerns that the current government is not upholding the UDHR.
The Judge decides which peasants require compensation of 1 hour which is paid for by government leaders.
The Judge can remove up to 4 government oppressions.
[NO EFFECT UNDER DEMOCRACY]
[IF NO JUDGE IS IN PLAY, DISCARD THIS SCENARIO CARD]

effects.text: No Judge or under Democracy: no effect. The Judge picks peasants to be paid 1 hour by government leaders and can remove up to 4 oppressions.

scenario.title: Jury Corruption
scenario.text:
The Judge has been called into hold jury members accountable for corruption. The Judge decides which alive players should be considered for a shorten jail sentence.
For each alive player they select, the Judge needs to roll 5 or higher for the alive player to be sent to Jail. The cost of Jail for the alive player is half the cost when they leave.
[IF NO JUDGE IS IN PLAY, DISCARD THIS SCENARIO CARD]

effects.text: No Judge in play? Discard this card. The Judge picks players; each is jailed on the Judge's roll of 5+, with half the jail fee.

scenario.title: Government Over-spending
scenario.text:
Government over-spending leads to increased living costs for all.
All Public Service jobs are removed from their posts.
All players must pay 3 hours to cover their costs through the winter months.

scenario.title: Secret Police
scenario.text:
In order to cut down on illegal activities, the secret police have been deployed.
All Illicit jobs are removed from their posts.
All players roll the die one at a time to see if they are sanctioned with +1 heat (5+ to avoid the sanction).

scenario.title: Time Bank Collapse
scenario.text:
Due to giving out too many loans, the Time Bank collapses.
All Finance jobs are removed from their posts.
All players must discard two collectables.

effects.text: Every player discards two collectables.

scenario.title: Sexual Misconduct
scenario.text:
Whilst at work, the SHAG officer has called you in about a work party where you stripped in the office.
Lose your job.
You have the option to take your employer to court (roll 5 or higher for A):
A) You become the SHAG officer yourself (choose an available job of your choice)
B) The SHAG officer shafts you (-4 hours, +2 heat).

success.text: You become the SHAG officer: choose an available job in the You panel.

scenario.title: AIDS
scenario.text:
All players are infected with contaminated blood with AIDS from the state hospital.
All players receive 30 minutes bleeding effect.

scenario.title: Child Support
scenario.text:
A former partner has demanded you pay child support and takes you to court (roll 5 or higher for A):
A) A DNA test proves you are not the parent.
B) You are sanctioned for not supporting your child(ren)’s upbringing (-4 hours, +2 heat).

scenario.title: Bank Robbery
scenario.text:
You decide to rob the Time Bank. Ask if any other players would like to assist you robbing the Time Bank.
Each willing player in turn attempts to rob the Time Bank by rolling a 6 or higher.
The player who rolls 6+ is in charge of distributing the loot of 12 hours between the contributing players, regardless if they drew this card or not.
If all players are unsuccessful, they are sent to court for attempted armed robbery.

effects.text: Willing players each try to roll 6 to rob the Time Bank; whoever does shares out 12 hours. If everyone fails, they all go to court.

scenario.title: Murder
scenario.text:
You have been framed for a murder and you appear in court (roll 5 or higher for A):
A) A good lawyer saves you from the situation.
B) You are found guilty (+2 heat).

scenario.title: Bounty Board
scenario.text:
Bounties have been placed on big earners in the city.
Fill up all six assignment slots.
The next two assignments can be completed against any player with a title.
The assignment reward is doubled, and in addition any assignment completed against those with a title will be demoted.
[KEEP CARD OUT UNTIL TWO ASSIGNMENTS HAVE BEEN COMPLETED]

effects.text: Fill all six assignment slots. The next two assignments can target anyone with a title: double reward, and the target is demoted. Keep this card out until two are completed.

scenario.title: Divorce
scenario.text:
Your partner demands a divorce in court (roll 5 or higher for A):
A) You take back your possessions your partner took from you (draw two collectables)
B) Your cheating lifestyle is shown in court (lose half of your time (max loss 8 hours, +2 heat).

scenario.title: Gerry’s Slot Machine
scenario.text:
Roll the black die. Each charm adds 1 to the black die.
8 - You win the game
7 - Become Executive or +8 hours
6 - Reset bleed & heat counters to 0.
5 - Move directly to any tile
4 - +2 collectables
3 - Draw scenario card
2 - -3 hours
1 - Arrested

5.text: Move directly to any tile: click it on the board.

effects.text: Each charm adds 1: 7 = become Executive or +8 hours, 8 = you win the game.

scenario.title: Gambling Addict
scenario.text:
Your gambling debt catches up on you… and you owe 4 hours to state support.
You have the option to pay now, or gamble it (roll 5 or higher):
A) You score big and clear your debt with some return (+2 hours)
B) You lose further so the debt is now doubled. You are sent to court to decide the matter.

effects.text: Pay 4 hours now, or gamble: roll 5+ to get +2 hours; otherwise the debt doubles and goes to court.

scenario.title: Annual Bonus
scenario.text:
After a prosperous financial year, all Financial job holders are rewarded with a bonus.
Tier 1 holders receive +1 hour.
Tier 2 holders receive +2 hours.
Tier 3 holders receive +3 hours.
Any Finance Title holders receive +4 hours.

scenario.title: Loan Sharks
scenario.text:
The Loan Sharks have come to claim their debts on behalf of the Illicit job holders.
Each Illicit job holder can call in the debt on a player of their choice who are not part of the Illicit faction.
You can choose one of the following for your victim:
A) Claim back (receive) 3 hours
B) Steal 2 collectables (of your victim’s choice).

effects.text: Each Illicit job holder picks a non-Illicit victim: take 3 hours from them, or 2 collectables (their choice).

scenario.title: Fire Sale
scenario.text:
All Public Service job holders receive a promotion card!
All Public Service job holders have the one-time opportunity to purchase two of the following for reduced prices:
*Job Opportunity – 10 minutes
*Hospital Item – 20 minutes
*Collectable OR Shortcut – 30 minutes.
These purchases are not affected by democracy.

effects.text: Public Service job holders may each buy two of: Job Opportunity 10 min, Hospital Item 20 min, Collectable or Shortcut 30 min (not doubled by Democracy).

scenario.title: Curfew
scenario.text:
A military curfew is immediately implemented and all players are caught outside. Roll 5 or higher for A (3 or higher for government leaders):
A) You make it inside without being caught (move to the next named building tile & action the tile).
B) You were shot in the leg and caught (+30 minutes bleeding effect, +1 heat).

effects.text: Everyone who made it inside moves to the next named building tile and actions it.

scenario.title: Reputation
scenario.text:
A game show is introduced to highlight who is negatively contributing to society.
All players have the opportunity to vote for the player they want to lose time anonymously via a straw poll.
Each vote is worth 1.5 hours.

effects.text: Anonymous straw poll: every vote against a player costs them 1.5 hours.

scenario.title: Insurance Fraud
scenario.text:
Your home insurance provider is refusing to pay out for a fire as they believe you started it.
Pay 2 hours to fix the damages caused to your house.
You have the option to take your insurance provider to court (roll 5 or higher for A):
A) Your insurance provider pays out (+6 hours)
B) You lose, and must pay for damages and legal fees (-4 hours, +2 heat).

scenario.title: Revolution!
scenario.text:
The Soviet National Anthem is played and there is an immediate revolution.
Current government leaders and advisors are sanctioned with +1 heat (no affect under democracy)
The current government is changed randomly to one of the three other government choices.

effects.text: The government changes at random to one of the three others: the admin sets it.

scenario.title: No Confidence Vote
scenario.text:
Calls for new leadership leads a vote of no confidence in the current government leaders.
Each government leader faces a vote in their leadership; if removed, they cannot be the next leader.
If there is a Judge in play, they can decide the outcome of one government leader.
[IGNORE THIS CARD IF THE CURRENT GOVERNMENT IS DEMOCRACY]

effects.text: Ignore under Democracy. Each government leader faces a vote; anyone removed can't be the next leader. A Judge can decide one leader's outcome.

scenario.title: Time Laundering
scenario.text:
You have been contracted to launder 8 hours of time from illegal investments.
If the launder the time to your account, you must roll 4 or higher for success. If you launder the time to another player, you or the player must roll 3 or higher for success.
Time must be laundered in 2 hour quantities.
Any failed attempts sends player(s) to court for their totalled failed laundered time.

effects.text: Launder 8 hours in 2-hour lots: to yourself roll 4+, to another player roll 3+. Failed attempts go to court for the failed amount.

scenario.title: RNLI
scenario.text:
You were out fishing late at night and the tide swept you in. You were saved by the RNLI but now you must now pay their fees… (roll 5 or higher for A:)
A) You are charged 3 hours.
B) You are charged 8 hours.
To pay the debt, you must pay between 1-3 hours inclusive per turn. However at the end of your turn the debt earns interest of 30 minutes.
[KEEP CARD UNTIL YOU HAVE PAID IN FULL]

effects.text: Pay 1–3 hours a turn; 30 minutes interest is added at the end of each turn. Keep the card until it's paid.

scenario.title: Mafia
scenario.text:
The Mafia have entered the city and demand payment from all players.
Starting with the player who drew this card and continuing clockwise, players roll the die until they first roll a 6.
Each player pays 30 minutes for each roll until they roll a 6.

scenario.title: Income Tax
scenario.text:
A capital policy is introduced to curve all citizen’s income. When you land on Collectables Promotions, you must pay tax depending on your job & title:
No job = 0.5 hours
Tier 1/2 = 1 hour
Tier 3 = 1.5 hours
Title holders = 2 hours
To remove this policy, a lump sum of 24 hours must be donated to the state.
[THIS SCENARIO CARD APPLIES TO ALL PLAYERS AND IS ONLY REMOVED ONCE PAID]

effects.text: Ongoing: on Collectables Promotions tiles pay tax (no job 30m, Tier 1/2 1h, Tier 3 1.5h, title 2h) until 24 hours are donated to the state.

Change the target of a current assignment slip to a specific player.
OR
Introduce a new assignment.

You cannot advance beyond the Black Market Tile.

governments.Full card text:
All players make up the governing body.
No government oppressions can be implemented.
All purchases are double in price.

All players share 50% of their current time equally among all alive players.
Two random players make up the Politburo.
Leaders can use a max of two oppressions per turn.
Each Politburo leader receives +20 minutes income per turn.
Each peasant donates 20 minutes per turn to the state.

The dictator is chosen by one-vote blind auction. All decisions are made by the dictator.
The Dictator can use a max of three oppressions per turn.
Dictator receives +30 minutes income per turn.
Cost of Jail is increased by 4 hours for all peasants.

Head of State receives +20 minutes income per turn; advisors receive +10 minutes income per turn.
Collectable Promotions tiles no longer grant a free collectable.
